item.title: 383: Harry Samit - Arresting Zacarias Moussaoui, The "20th Hijacker” - Jerri Williams
item.description: A review of the JTTF investigation of Zacarias Moussaoui, a co-conspirator in the September 11 attacks, who trained to fly commercial plane.

item.title: 384: Bob Anderson and Carl Larsen – Citizen Hero Lou Peters, Bonanno Crime Family - Jerri Williams
item.description: A review of Lou Peters cooperation in the investigation of mobster Joseph Bonanno, Sr., the leader of the California based mob family.

item.title: 385: Jerri Williams - 10th Anniversary Show and Listener Q and A - Jerri Williams
item.description: This is the 10th anniversary show for FBI Case File Review. The first episode sharing FBI stories was released on January 22nd, 2016.

item.title: 386: Barry Black – Hazardous Devices, FBI Special Agent Bomb Tech - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review of the Oklahoma City Bombing case and two more cases from the book Hazardous Devices about being an FBI special agent bomb tech.

item.title: 387: Phil Andrew – NY Times Reporter Kidnapped By Taliban, Hostage Negotiation - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review by a negotiator who drew upon his own history as a hostage to negotiate for the release of victims kidnapped by Taliban terrorists.

item.title: 388: Jerry Spurgers – Disappearance and Murder of Federal Witness, Death Crime Scenes - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review of the investigation of the disappearance and murder of federal witness Susan Cooper and evidence collection at death crime scenes.

item.title: 389: George Olivo – Polygraph Exam of Female Murderer, A&E Lie Detector Series - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review of the polygraph examination a woman suspected of murdering her boyfriend and a discussion about the A&E Lie Detector series.

item.title: 390: Geoffrey Kelly – Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum Heist, Thirteen Perfect Fugitives - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review of the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum heist, the largest in history, and Thirteen Perfect Fugitives, written by the FBI case agent.

item.title: 391: Gerry Bianchi – Tales from a Tech Agent, Mob Wars and More - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review of cases where tech agents surreptitiously installed recording devices in the residences and/or businesses of Philly mob members.

item.title: 392: Larry Wansley – Early Days of Undercover Program, Corrupt Texas Sheriff - Jerri Williams
item.description: Review of the early years of the FBI’s undercover program and the corruption investigation of Gregg County, Texas Sheriff Tom Welch.
